notes.title: Update #10 - Full Release: 30 new challenges!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291365/b549448ec5e309d666d34cdcb5bdb8f6cfe96d91.png[/img]
With today's update, we're doubling the number of challenges previously offered in the game. Experience a whole campaign of 30 new challenges; beat them all for an unlock!  We're also moving to full release as we feel we've reached the content threshold.

Two new units have arrived as well.  The first is the Phoenix, a massive firebird who sets fire to any beast he touches.  The second is the Jeep, a mechanical beast who beeps at and runs over his prey.

[h1]Patch Notes: [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Added a new set of 30 challenges
    [*]Added Phoenix
    [*]Added Jeep
[/list]

notes.title: Update #5 - Onslaught Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291365/08ee7a44afa6fb04ca18143751f32cc2be720d69.png[/img]
Today we're introducing a new gamemode called Onslaught.  In Onslaught mode, you'll have to protect a tower from waves of incoming enemies by spawning units in real-time.  Before each round begins, you must build up your stock of units which you'll pull from during the action.  You'll also have access to 6 spells which you can cast during battle to assist your units.  

We've included 6 levels to start with.  Hope you guys enjoy!

[h1]Patch Notes: [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Added Onslaught mode with 6 levels.
    [*]Increased shark price to 400
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1 - We added a tank!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291365/393996608c3ded8caa1ac3621f6551c57a31a521.png[/img]
For our first update, we've decided to add a non-beast unit to sandbox mode.  We thought it would be really cool if the game had a tank, so we added one.  

This tank has the ability to absolutely obliterate animals, and you can even gear it up with weapons, or have it play soccer, or control it yourself!  We'd like to gauge your reactions to this unusual unit, let us know if you'd like more non-beast units, anything is on the table at this point.


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added Tank to sandbox mode
    [*]Improved turret stability during player control
[/list]

tags.bug: Improved turret stability during player control
